title: JIM Manifest
description: Metadata, and optionally inline data, needed to present a ParaCharts element, as a root form JIM document. @public

datasets.description: Metadata, and optionally inline data, needed to present a chart in ParaCharts.

annotations.description: Annotations on the chart and its data.

dataset.description: A set of data and parameters needed to present a chart in ParaCharts.

representation.description: In what form the data is presented in the ParaChart element.

type.description: The type of the visualization, which is always 'chart'.

subtype.description: The type of the chart, such as 'line' or 'column'.

structure.description: Describes how the chart groups, nests, or otherwise organizes one or more facets.

description.description: A manually created description of the whole chart.

topic.description: The overall topic of the chart. Defaults to the topic of the single series ONLY in single series charts.

facets.description: Metadata describing each facet of the chart which represents some dimension of the data.

series.description: Metadata, and possibly inline data, describing the series of the chart.

href.description: An external data source for this dataset.

path.description: The location of the external data file.
path.$comment: Additional validation?: check path is a URL or a relative path.

format.description: The format of the data file.
format.$comment: Additional validation?: check format is a MIME type.

facet.description: Metadata describing a facet of the chart which represents some dimension of the data.

label.description: A text label for the quantity measured by this facet.

description.description: An extended text description for the quantity measured by this facet.

variableType.description: Whether the variable this facet measures depends on the variable measured by another facet or facets.

measure.description: The NOIR data scale of the quantity this facet measures.

datatype.description: The primitive type of the data measured by this facet.

displayType.description: How this facet should be displayed on the chart

units.description: The units for the data of this facet, in singular form, if any. This value should be absent if the facet measures a dimensionless quantity. If the units for this facet of the chart are fractional, then this is only the numerator of that fraction.

multiplier.description: The number each datum of this facet must be multiplied by to get the true value. Defaults to 1.

seriesManifest.description: Metadata, and possibly inline data, describing a series on the chart.

key.description: A unique identifier for the series, which may have spaces, punctuation, or other non-alphanumeric characters that aren't allowed in DOM ids, but which still may not be suitable for the text label.

label.description: The text label for the series, which may be abbreviated or expanded from the series key. Defaults to key.

records.description: The datapoints of this series represented inline.

topic.description: The topic of a series or chart.

baseQuantity.description: The base quantity or quantities measured by the series or chart, such as 'item price' or 'inflation rate'.

baseKind.description: What kind of base quantity this is: either a number of things (number), a quantity measured by a unit (dimensioned), a rate of change (rate), or a proportion of a whole (proportion).

locale.description: The particular location or locations that the quantity measured by this series or chart is limited to, if any.

entity.description: The particular entity or entities the quantity measured by this series or chart belongs to, if any.

items.description: A general term or terms for the multiple, indefinite items the quantity measured by this series or chart belongs to, if any.

aggregate.description: The statistical aggregate or aggregates measured by this series or chart, such as 'total' or 'estimated', if any.

denominator.description: If the units for this facet of the chart are fractional, then this is the denominator of that fraction. For example: '(per) capita', '(per) million inhabitants'. If this property is present, then every series on the chart must measure a fractional quantity, of which this will also be the denominator.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the point relative to the facet labelled by this property key.

datapointManifest.$comment: Additional validation: These properties must match those in `facets`.

name.description: The name of something, as a non-empty string.

nameOrNames.description: Either the name of a single thing, as a non-empty string, or multiple things, as an array of names.

seriesName.description: The name of a series, as a non-empty string. This is identical to `name`, but specified for semantic reasons

displayType.description: How a facet should be displayed on the graph.

type.description: What type of chart element represents the facet.

orientation.description: What type of chart element represents the facet.

minDisplayed.description: The lowest value displayed on this axis of the chart. Defaults to zero for the dependent axis and the minimum independent value of any series for the independent axis.

maxDisplayed.description: The highest value label displayed on this axis of the chart. Defaults to the maximum value of any series relative to this axis.

displayType.$comment: Additional validation: The other properties should be only those relevant to the type.

representationStructure.description: Describes how the chart groups, nests, or otherwise organizes one or more facets.

role.description: A lowercase ASCII token naming the intended organizational role of the step.
role.$comment: Additional validation: Check that the role is only lowercase ASCII.

facetKeys.description: An array of facet keys which are organized according to the role.
facetKeys.$comment: Additional validation: Check that the keys all match keys in facets.

annotation.description: An annotation on the chart or its data.

id.description: A document-local identifier for the annotation.
id.$comment: Warning: Validators should report duplicate ids.

target.description: The thing or things being annotated.

body.description: The content of an annotation as a localized text map.
body.$comment: Additional validation: check all properties are valid BCP 47 language tags

bodyType.description: The MIME type used to interpret the strings in `body`. Defaults to `text/plain`.
bodyType.$comment: Additional validation: check this is a valid MIME type

status.description: The workflow status of the annotation. Defaults to `{ "value": "active" }`.

created.description: The date and timestamp when this annotation was created.

modified.description: The date and timestamp when this annotation was last modified.

generated.description: The date and timestamp when this annotation was generated.

replaces.description: The ids of the annotations that this annotation supersedes.
replaces.$comment: Warning: Validators should report unknown ids?

jimTarget.description: The thing or things being annotated.

ref.description: A document-local reference to a JIM resource with the matching id.

dom.description: A selector for rendered DOM/SVG content.
dom.$comment: Additional validation: check for DOM/SVG correctness?

json.description: A JSONPath into JIM data, metadata, bindings, annotations, or other JSON resources.
json.$comment: Additional validation: check for JSONPath correctness?

region.description: A graphical region expressed using SVG-JSON-Shapes.
region.$comment: Additional validation: JIM does not define geometry itself. Region shapes are expressed through the companion SVG-JSON-Shapes document.

jimAnnotationStatus.description: The workflow status of an annotation.

value.description: The workflow status of the annotation.

setBy.description: The agent who set this workflow status.

setAt.description: The date and timestamp when this workflow status was set.

note.description: Additional notes on this workflow status.

agentRef.description: A person, organization, or software agent.

agentRefObj.description: The details of a person, organization, or software agent.

id.description: An ID code for the agent.

type.description: What type of agent this is.

version.description: The version of the software for a software agent.

timestamp.description: The date and time when something occurred in ISO 8601.
timestamp.$comment: Additional validation: check this is a ISO 8601 date-time string
